guidance.heading: Choosing a push-in fitting
guidance.body: Choose by tube O.D. first, then by the thread at the port: NPT male, NPT female, or tube-to-tube. Cut the tube square with a tube cutter and push it fully home past the O-ring. These fittings are for compressed air only.

standards.heading: Threads and rating

products.title: Push-to-Connect Male Connector, Tube × NPT
products.descriptionShort: Push-to-Connect Male Connector, Tube × NPT for inch air tube, 0–150 psi. 6 part numbers, 5/32" to 1/2" O.D. tube; the size table gives the size on each end.
products.descriptionLong:
The Push-to-Connect Male Connector, Tube × NPT is a straight male connector for inch outside-diameter plastic air tube. Push the tube in and the stainless gripping teeth and O-ring hold and seal it; press the release collet and pull to take it out, with no tools.

Ends and sealing

  • Push-in end: takes nylon or polyurethane air tube cut square; an internal O-ring seals on the tube O.D.
  • NPT end: tapered pipe thread (1/8" to 1/2" NPT) to ASME B1.20.1, supplied with a sealant coating or an O-ring on the thread.

Construction

Nickel-plated brass body, POM release collet.

Sizes

6 part numbers, 5/32" to 1/2" O.D. tube, 1/8" to 1/2" NPT threads. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab gives the size on each end for every one.

Rating

Published by the manufacturer: working pressure 0 to 150 psi (0 to 9.9 bar), vacuum to −29.5 inHg, temperature 32 °F to 140 °F (0 °C to 60 °C). For compressed air only; not for other gases, water, oil or hydraulic service.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the tube O.D. and the thread. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

products.descriptionLong:
The Push-to-Connect Plug is a plug for an unused push-in port for inch outside-diameter plastic air tube. Push the tube in and the stainless gripping teeth and O-ring hold and seal it; press the release collet and pull to take it out, with no tools.

Ends and sealing

  • Push-in end: takes nylon or polyurethane air tube cut square; an internal O-ring seals on the tube O.D.

Construction

Engineering-plastic body, POM release collet.

Sizes

2 part numbers, 1/4" to 1/2" O.D. tube. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab gives the size on each end for every one.

Rating

Published by the manufacturer: working pressure 0 to 150 psi (0 to 9.9 bar), vacuum to −29.5 inHg, temperature 32 °F to 140 °F (0 °C to 60 °C). For compressed air only; not for other gases, water, oil or hydraulic service.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the tube O.D. and the thread. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
products.seoDescription: Push-to-Connect Plug for inch nylon or PU air tube, 0-150 psi: 2 sizes, 1/4" to 1/2" O.D. tube. Quote from Indus Hydraulics, UAE.

faqs.question: What tube does it fit?
faqs.answer: Inch outside-diameter nylon or polyurethane air tube, 1/4" to 1/2" O.D. tube. Cut the tube square and push it fully home.

faqs.question: What pressure is it rated for?
faqs.answer: 0 to 150 psi working pressure and vacuum to −29.5 inHg, at 32 °F to 140 °F, as published by the manufacturer.

faqs.question: Can it be used for water or hydraulic oil?
faqs.answer: No. It is rated for compressed air only.

faqs.question: How do I release the tube?
faqs.answer: Push the collet towards the fitting body and pull the tube out.

faqs.question: What is the lead time?
faqs.answer: Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
